LOW_EVIDENCE.label: Little evidence
LOW_EVIDENCE.meaning: No official confirmation that the supplier offers this product.

STALE_INFORMATION.label: Outdated data
STALE_INFORMATION.meaning: The latest information about the supplier is old and may no longer be accurate.

UNVERIFIED_MANUFACTURER.label: Manufacturer not verified
UNVERIFIED_MANUFACTURER.meaning: The company calls itself a manufacturer, but no registry or official catalogue confirms it.

UNKNOWN_LEGAL_STATUS.label: Legal status unknown
UNKNOWN_LEGAL_STATUS.meaning: The registration and status of the legal entity could not be checked.

AMBIGUOUS_ENTITY.label: Possible duplicate
AMBIGUOUS_ENTITY.meaning: This record may refer to the same company as another record. They were not merged automatically.

NO_PROCUREMENT_HISTORY.label: No procurement history
NO_PROCUREMENT_HISTORY.meaning: The available data contains no procurements involving this supplier.
